dedupe_keys.name: trnsys simulation database for passive building design university of stuttgart

description: This dataset is a complete database of thermal building simulations run in TRNSYS for research on passive measures for sustainable building design, holding simulation inputs, results and metadata. It was published on Zenodo on 30 January 2025 (version 1.0.0) by Luisa Claus and Simon Joller of the University of Stuttgart. Inputs vary geometry, weather and materials, so the database pairs design parameters with transient thermal performance results. Coverage: the weather locations and building variants included in the database, which the record does not list. Access: one 25 GB SQL file with a README on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: large to load, and the parameter ranges and climates must be read from the database itself. Simulation uses: surrogate models and data-driven optimisation of passive design, and design validation. Related records: PyE+ and the Flanders simulated heating demand dataset.
